changelog:
* **Weight alerts.** Set the percentage you want to hear about (default 70%). You are told once when the weight crosses your mark, and once more at 90% where the character can no longer attack or pick anything up - and nothing in between, so farming past your own line does not repeat itself. A line re-arms only after the weight really comes down.
* **Send All (Preview).** A button in the alerts dialog that sends a sample of every alert type - low HP, death, level ups, whispers, card / gear / costume drops, both weight stages and a stalled stream - with placeholder names, so you can see how each one looks before it matters. They come from the same code the live alerts use.
* Release notes now carry their own summary instead of pointing at a file that was never published.
